tools.description: Every US import tariff layer for one HTS code from one country of origin, from the Zentria Flow engine: MFN duty, China Section 301, the forced-labor Section 301 tariff, Section 232 and Section 338 on Canada, with the total rate, exemptions, USMCA/CAFTA-DR cases and dated changes ahead. tools.name: compare_origins
tools.description: The US tariff layers of one HTS code from 2 to 6 countries of origin, side by side, lowest total first. Duty only: freight, fees and supplier price are not compared. Planning estimate, not a customs ruling.

tools.name: hts_search
tools.description: Find US tariff lines (8-digit HTSUS codes) by product words or the start of a code, from the official HTSUS descriptions. Use it to get a code for us_tariff_check. A search hit is a candidate, not a classification ruling.
